notices.reorder_same_priority: The order can only be changed within the same priority level – set the priority first.
notices.nothing_to_pause: There are no running or waiting transfers.
notices.nothing_to_resume: There are no paused or blocked transfers.
notices.paused_count: No transfers were paused. | {count} transfer was paused. | {count} transfers were paused.
notices.resumed_count: No transfers were started. | {count} transfer was started or resumed. | {count} transfers were started or resumed.
notices.nothing_to_clear: There are no matching entries for this action.
notices.remove_failed: The entry could not be removed.
notices.nothing_to_reset: Nothing in the selection can be reset right now – active transfers have to be paused first
notices.reorder_filter_active: The order can only be changed in the unfiltered list – the hidden files would otherwise be sorted wrongly.
notices.cleared_packages: No packages were removed. | {count} package was removed. | {count} packages were removed.
notices.clear_skipped: No packages were left untouched. | {count} package was left untouched – {reason}: {names}. | {count} packages were left untouched – {reason}: {names}.

notifications.queue_done_body: No files finished. | {count} file finished. | {count} files finished.

confirm.delete_package_description: Remove “{name}” with all its files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.delete_packages_description: Remove {count} packages with all their files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} package with all its files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} packages with all their files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted.
confirm.delete_packages_label: Delete {count} packages | Delete {count} package | Delete {count} packages
confirm.remove_files_description: Remove {count} files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} file from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted.
confirm.clear_completed: Really remove every package whose files have all finished? A package that is still working is left untouched, and finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.clear_failed: Really remove every finished package that contains a failed file, including its incomplete files? A package that is still working is left untouched.
confirm.clear_all: Really remove every package that has stopped working, whatever the outcome? A package with running, waiting or seeding files is left untouched, and finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.remove_download_completed: Remove the entry from the download list? The finished file is kept.
confirm.remove_download_partial: Remove the entry from the download list? An existing incomplete file is deleted as well.
confirm.delete_package_active: “{name}” is still working. Remove it anyway? Its running downloads are cancelled and their incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.delete_packages_active: Remove {count} package(s), {busy} of which are still working? Running downloads are cancelled and their incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.

rename_file.title: Rename file
rename_file.label: File name
rename_file.description: The new name is used when the file is saved.

bulk.category_whole_packages: The category applies to whole packages – select all files of a package
bulk.priority_whole_packages: The priority applies to whole packages – select all files of a package

bulk.level_whole_packages: The post-processing level applies to whole packages – select all files of a package
bulk.level_packages_only: The postprocess level exists for link packages only, not for NZB imports.
bulk.extract_no_archive: The selection contains no finished archive files

package.resume_all_aria: Start or resume all downloads in the package
package.force_extract_title: Run post-processing once despite the failed check
package.delete_title: Remove the whole package from the list
package.complete_title: All files in this package are finished
package.eta_aria: Estimated remaining time for this package {duration}
package.hand_over_hint: The provider fetches this package's NZB from Usenet itself; the finished files come back into the LinkGrabber as links. The package stays here.

transfer.drag_title: Drag to change the order inside the package

sources.title: Sources ({count})
sources.no_pieces: No piece hashes; the whole-file hash is checked before completion when there is one.

isolated_reason.piece: Delivered data that did not match its hash.
isolated_reason.other: No longer used for this file.
isolated_reason.internal: Points at your own machine or into a network this source list may not reach.

sources.unsupported_hint: Sources whose protocol this service cannot fetch are shown but not used.

summary.title: Statistics
summary.remaining_hint: open transfers, paused and post-processing included
summary.eta_hint: at the current speed, downloading entries only

edit_package.title: Edit package
edit_package.description: Name and archive password for extraction.
edit_package.name: Package name
edit_package.password_stored: The stored password is shown here and can be edited; clearing it removes it.
edit_package.password_optional: Optional; the password list (passwords.txt) is tried as well.
edit_package.postprocess_level_hint: Inherit uses the category or global default.
edit_package.script_hint: Runs after post-processing; Inherit uses the category or global default.
edit_package.script_empty: No scripts found in the scripts directory.
edit_package.rename_folder_hint: Moves the files on disk. A folder of that name that already exists is refused.
edit_package.speed_limit_hint: Empty = no limit of its own. The global and the profile limits still apply; the strictest wins.
edit_package.speed_limit_unsupported: A package holding a torrent takes no limit of its own: the torrent engine cannot limit a single torrent.

rail.eta_title: Estimated remaining time at the current speed
rail.selection_partial_title: {count} selected, at least {size} in total – the size of {unknown} is not known yet
rail.parallel_limit_title: How many downloads may run at once ({min}–{max}); applies at once, without a restart
rail.parallel_range: Between {min} and {max} downloads may run at once.

free_download_hint: No provider account – the file is fetched as a free/direct download

capacity.title: "{name}" is out of space
capacity.description: {free} free, {required} required. Downloads for this destination are paused; every other destination keeps running.
capacity.unknown_size: The next transfer does not state a size, so the configured headroom applies.
capacity.manual_hint: Automatic resume is switched off, so this destination stays paused until it is resumed here.

reset.title: Reset {count} download? | Reset {count} downloads?
reset.description: Everything downloaded so far is discarded and the transfer starts again from the beginning.
reset.more_files: and {count} more file | and {count} more files
reset.delete_files_hint: Cannot be undone. Left switched off, the finished file stays and the new attempt lands beside it.

hints.rename: The new file lands beside the existing one as “name (1)”; nothing is lost.
hints.skip: The new file is not written; the existing one stays as it is and the download ends with a note.
hints.overwrite: The new file replaces the existing one. Recorded in the audit log, and never done over a file that is being transferred or seeded.
hints.compare: The contents are compared: identical bytes adopt the existing file, different ones are renamed.
hints.ask: The download waits until somebody decides. Only this download waits, and the question survives a restart.

prompts.title: “{name}” already exists
prompts.before_transfer: Package {package}: a file of this name is already at the destination ({size}). Nothing has been downloaded yet.
prompts.after_transfer: Package {package}: the name was taken while the transfer ran ({size}). The verified file waits in the staging folder.
prompts.only_this: Only this download waits; the rest of the queue keeps running.
prompts.failed: The decision could not be saved.

collision.label: On a name collision
collision.package_description: Applies to this package’s files before the category and the global setting.

duplicates.source_description: The same thing was asked for before – recognised by {kind}, before a byte is fetched.

identity.nzb: the NZB’s hash and the file name

basis.verified_hash: The same bytes are already on disk – recognised by the verified SHA-256 of the finished file.
basis.stated_checksum: Not finished yet: compared with the SHA-256 the source stated.
basis.none: No hash known yet: content duplicates show once the file is finished and verified.

duplicates.link_title: Replaces the chosen file by a hard link to this identical file. Both are hashed first.
duplicates.other_file_system: another file system – no link possible
duplicates.linked: Linked; {size} are no longer stored twice.

storage_modal.title: Collisions and duplicates: {name}
storage_modal.description: What happens when a file name is taken, and which of the package’s files already exist.

clear_everything.title: Clear the entire list?
clear_everything.description: Removes {count} package from the download list. | Removes all {count} packages from the download list.
clear_everything.active: No package is active any more. | {count} of them is still active: running and waiting downloads are cancelled and seeding stops. | {count} of them are still active: running and waiting downloads are cancelled and seeding stops.
clear_everything.kept: Finished files stay in their destination folder. A package that is being post-processed stays in the list.
clear_everything.delete_partial_hint: Cannot be undone: unfinished torrent data and fragments beside the target file. Incomplete files in the staging folder are always removed.

pause.until_hint: Downloads continue by themselves at this time – today, or tomorrow if it has already passed.
pause.remaining_title: The queue continues in {duration}. Click to resume now.

kill_switch.title: Torrents paused by the kill switch
kill_switch.description: The bound interface {name} is gone. Torrents stay paused until it returns; other downloads carry on.
